records.title: BatGPT-Chem: A Foundation Large Model for Chemical Engineering
records.reason: The primary abstract identifies a 15B chemical-engineering model without a claimed serving optimization, but the linked KV-cache lineage makes full-text review material; publisher full text was inaccessible, so retain as borderline rather than exclude on abstract alone.

records.title: Representation Engineering for Large-Language Models: Survey and Research Challenges
records.reason: Full survey discusses inference-time representation control and makes latency/cost claims, but presents no concrete measured inference-efficiency method; retain as a weak lineage-related lead rather than excluding from abstract alone.

records.title: 23.8 An 88.36TOPS/W Bit-Level-Weight-Compressed Large-Language-Model Accelerator with Cluster-Aligned INT-FP-GEMM and Bi-Dimensional Workflow Reformulation
records.reason: Official publisher page returned an anti-bot challenge and no paper body; accelerator/weight compression is directly plausible, so preserve as borderline pending accessible publisher/author full text.

records.title: Energy-aware operation of HPC systems in Germany
records.reason: Scope is national HPC energy operations, not LLM inference algorithms or serving.

records.title: The Fire Thief Is Also the Keeper: Balancing Usability and Privacy in Prompts
records.reason: Paper addresses prompt design/privacy concerns, not inference efficiency.
